verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v1: jidda fī sayrihā falasta tulāmu hadhihi ṭaybatu wahadhā l-maqāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v2: ḥaramu ḥallahu nabiyyu karīmu waʾimāmu bijanbihi wahumāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v3: wajalālu wahaybatu wawaqāru wabahāʾu warifʿahu wāḥtirāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v4: hāhunā faṣ-ṣiqi l-fuʾāda lituṭfā ḥarratu shabbahā l-hawā waḍirāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v5: mut hunā lawʿata washawqā wawajdā wagharāmā famā ʿalayka malāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v6: naḥnu fī rawḍaḍi r-rasūli julūsu hadhihi yaqẓaḍu waʾillā manāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v7: falaka fī s-suʿūdi qad ḥalla fīhi qamaru ẓallalat ʿalayhi l-ghamāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v8: kayfa lā taskubu d-dumūʿa jufūnī wahyā min qabli ʾan tarāka sijāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v9: kayfa lā tadhhalu l-ʿuqūlu watafnā ʾanfusu l-ʿāshiqīna wahyā kirāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v10: yā rasūla l-ʾilahi ʾannī muḥibbu laka wallāhi shāʾiqu mustahāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v11: yā rasūla l-ʾilahi fī kulli ḥīni laka minnī taḥḥiyatu wasalāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v12: yā rasūla l-ʾilahi shawqī ʿaẓīmu zāʾidu wal-gharāmu fīka gharāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v13: yā rasūla l-ʾilahi jiʾituka ʾasʿā qayyadatnī dh-dhunūbu wahyā ʿiẓāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v14: yā rasūla l-ʾilahi ʾinnī nazīlu wanazīlu l-kirāmi laysa yuḍāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v15: ʾantumu maqṣadī lifaqrī waminkum yuʿrafu l-jūdu wal-wafā wadh-dhimāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v16: walakum ḥurmahu wajāhu ʿaẓīmu wawafāʾu warifʿahu lā turāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v17: laylata l-ʾisrā ʾahlu kulli samāʾi sajada l-kullu ʾidh raʾawka waqāmū
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v18: wataqaddamta liṣ-ṣalāti faṣallā kulluhum muqtadi waʾanta l-ʾimāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v19: yā najiyyā l-ʾilahi fī ḥaḍrati l-qud si karīmu lahu hunāka yuqāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v20: ʾanta nūru l-ʿuyūni ʾanta l-ʾamānī ʾanta rūḥu l-qulūbi ʾanta l-humāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v21: ʾanta yā sayyida n-nabiyyīna baḥru sabaḥa l-kullu fī nadāka waʿāmū
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v22: ʾanta lil-kulli ʾawwalu fī l-maʿālī wakadhā ʾanta lil-jamīʿi khitāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v23: ẓaharat kal-budūri nūrā waḥusnā fī samāʾi l-ʿulā waʾanta t-tamāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v24: watabaddat lanā kaʿiqdi nafīsi rāqa ḥusnā waʾanta ʾanta n-niẓāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v25: yā nabiyyā l-hudā maʿānīka tutlā ʿajazat ʾan tanālahā l-ʾafhāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v26: kayfa lā yartajī bnu masʿūdi ʿafwā walahu minka ḥurmahu wadhimām
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v27: yamdaḥu l-madḥa kulla yawmi biwaṣfi fīka yā man bihi yuzānu l-kalāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v28: yā ʾilaha s-samāʾi ṣalli ʿalayhi kullamā dāma liz-zamāni dawāmu
verses.jidda-fi-sayriha-c1-v29: waʿalā ʾālihi ʾajali l-barāyā waʿalā ṣaḥbihi l-jamīʿi s-salāmu
